{"consolidated_memory":"## crypto/keys/rotation.py: Signature mismatch in key rotation — seven distinct occasions (2026-02-01 through 2026-07-05)

**File:** crypto/keys/rotation.py (security side)

**Common symptom across all occasions:** Verification failure against the previous key

**Common reproducibility:** Rotate the signing key while requests are in flight

**Occasions:**

1. **[2026-02-01]** Flaky test failure
   - Trigger: Race condition during testing
   - Root cause: Race in lazy initialisation
   - Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
   - PR #1806, branch fix/signature-mismatch-1
   - Result: Flaky test went from 6 failures per hundred runs to zero

2. **[2026-03-22]** Large tenant performance degradation
   - Trigger: Accounts with more than ten thousand distinct keys
   - Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
   - Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
   - PR #4275, branch fix/signature-mismatch-3
   - Result: Job finished in 65 minutes instead of 7 hours

3. **[2026-04-29]** Duplicate data accumulation
   - Trigger: Users sitting in a negative UTC offset
   - Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except
   - Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
   - PR #4688, branch fix/signature-mismatch-4
   - Result: 94 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

4. **[2026-05-18]** Error rate spike
   - Trigger: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
   - Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
   - Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
   - PR #6167, branch fix/signature-mismatch-5
   - Result: Error rate dropped from 2.4 percent to under 2 per ten thousand

5. **[2026-05-21]** Storage bloat
   - Trigger: Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
   - Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
   - Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
   - PR #7482, branch fix/signature-mismatch-6
   - Result: Reclaimed 70 GB of blob storage

6. **[2026-06-01]** Memory exhaustion
   - Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
   - Root cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
   - Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
   - PR #8195, branch fix/signature-mismatch-7
   - Result: Memory settled at 848 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB

7. **[2026-07-05]** Throughput bottleneck for complex inputs
   - Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
   - Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
   - Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
   - PR #9777, branch fix/signature-mismatch-8
   - Result: Throughput rose 87 percent, to 658 requests per second"}
